PACIFIC INTERNATIONAL RUGBY CHAMPIONSHIP 2027 - MATCH REPORT DIGEST

The Pacific International Rugby Championship 2027 brought together eight national teams: New Zealand, Fiji, Japan, Samoa, Australia, Argentina, South Africa and Tonga.

The Pacific International Rugby Championship 2027 opened with Pool A and Pool B.

In Pool A, New Zealand v Fiji was played at Eden Park.

Japan v Samoa, the other Pool A fixture, took place at Sky Stadium.

Pool B began with Australia v Argentina at Forsyth Barr Stadium.

South Africa v Tonga, the second Pool B match, was staged at FMG Stadium Waikato.

McLean Park in Napier had been listed as a possible pool venue, but no match was scheduled there.

In the Pacific International Rugby Championship 2027 quarter-finals, Pool A winner v Pool B runner-up will be played at Orangetheory Stadium.

Semi-final and final fixtures have not yet been announced.
